tabDescription.authorization: Create and manage Bearer codes for access to QCopilots WebSearch.
tabDescription.search: Choose which web tools are available and configure your search provider.
tabDescription.status: View the current service version, listening addresses and provider availability.
clientsLoadFailed: Clients could not be loaded. Refresh to try again.
clientWelcomeHelp: Add a client and follow the three steps to create an active Bearer code and copy its connection details.
clientConflictHelp: Your draft is still here. Reload the client list, review the changes and save again when ready.
clientRandomHelp: Generate a new random 64-character Bearer code on this machine.
clientDraftReady: Code ready. Not saved or active yet.
clientDraftEmpty: Generate a code or enter one manually.
clientReplaceBeforeSave: The current code stays active until you save the replacement.
clientBeforeSave: The new code becomes active only after you save it in the next step.
clientReviewReplace: Save a new code for {id}? Its current code will stop working for new requests immediately.
clientReviewNew: Save this code to authorize {id} to use the web tools.
clientSaveEffect: Saving activates this code immediately. The next step lets you copy the connection details.
clientConnectHelp: In QCopilots MCP Servers, enable Authorization and paste the Bearer code. The managed Web Search service already has its address. Other MCP clients use the server URL below.
clientUrlUnavailable: The server URL is unavailable. Check Service status before connecting another MCP client.
clientOneTimeCopy: Copy your Bearer code now. It is held only on this page and is cleared when you finish, switch client or tab, refresh, or sign out. Saved codes cannot be retrieved.
clientSavePreview: Confirm and save the code to activate it immediately.
clientCopyPreview: Copy the address and Bearer for your MCP client.
clientExistingHelp: This client's saved code is never displayed. Replace it to create a new code, or revoke access to stop new requests.
clientStoredHidden: Saved codes cannot be displayed or retrieved.
clientNoLongerExists: This client was removed in another session. Cancel this replacement and add a new client if needed.
settingsDescription: Manage client access, available web tools and search providers.
signInDescription: Enter your administrator token or open a one-time sign-in link.
signInCommand: To get a one-time link, run {command}.
searchDescription: Allow QCopilots to search for information online.
openDescription: Allow QCopilots to open and read web pages.
clientsDescription: Create a code for each client. In QCopilots MCP Servers, turn on authorization and enter the code as the bearer value.
clientsEmpty: No client is authorized. Add a code to allow access to the web tools.
clientsPendingRestart: Some saved client changes have not taken effect. Restart the service, or save an authorization change here to apply all saved client changes.
clientDeleteConfirm: Revoke the authorization code for {id}? New requests using this code will be rejected. You can still sign in to this management page.
clientIdHelp: Use 1–64 letters, numbers, dots, underscores or hyphens. This name identifies the client and is separate from its code.
clientTokenHelp: Use 1–8192 visible ASCII characters without spaces. Short codes and / are accepted. You can copy the code after saving.
clientSourceTextHelp: The same text always produces the same 64-character code. Spaces, line breaks and letter case affect the result. This text is used only on this page and is never sent or saved.
clientCopyFailed: Could not copy. Select the displayed value and copy it manually.
clientGenerateFailed: Could not generate a code. Enter your own code or reload the page and try again.
clientSaved: Authorization code saved and active. A replaced code can no longer be used.
clientDeleted: Authorization code deleted. New requests using it will be rejected.
clientInvalidId: Enter a client name with 1–64 letters, numbers, dots, underscores or hyphens.
clientInvalidToken: Enter 1–8192 visible ASCII characters without spaces or control characters. The code is saved exactly as entered.
providerAuto: Automatic (DuckDuckGo, with Bing as a fallback)
keyOptional: A key is optional for SearXNG.
invalidEngines: Enter 1 to 20 unique engine names, each at most 100 characters.
settingsError: The settings file could not be loaded. The last valid settings are still active.
errors.invalid_argument: Check your input and try again.
errors.unauthorized: Sign in again or use a new sign-in link.
errors.forbidden: The server rejected this request. Reload the settings page and try again.
errors.not_found: The requested resource could not be found.
errors.revision_conflict: Settings changed in another session. Review the latest settings and try again.
errors.payload_too_large: The request exceeds the size limit.
errors.rate_limited: Too many requests. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.internal_error: The service could not complete the request.
errors.provider_not_configured: Configure the selected provider before testing it.
errors.timeout: The request timed out. Try again.
errors.unknown: The request failed. Check that the service is running and try again.
